description: Header file defining JNI interface and utility classes for PyTorch Android integration, including tracing, memory reading, and IValue conversion.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Utility class for managing Android tracing sections with initialization control.

classes.name: MemoryReadAdapter
classes.description: Implements a read adapter for memory buffers, conforming to caffe2 serialization interface.

classes.name: JIValue
classes.description: JNI wrapper for PyTorch IValue, supporting conversion to/from at::IValue and type codes.

methods.name: deviceJniCodeToDeviceType
methods.description: Converts JNI device code to c10::DeviceType.

methods.name: Trace::ensureInit
methods.description: Initializes tracing if not already initialized.

methods.name: Trace::beginSection
methods.description: Starts a tracing section with the given name.

methods.name: MemoryReadAdapter::size
methods.description: Returns the size of the data buffer.

methods.name: MemoryReadAdapter::read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer at a specified position.

methods.name: JIValue::newJIValueFromAtIValue
methods.description: Creates a new JIValue from an at::IValue, with optional dictionary callbacks.

methods.name: JIValue::JIValueToAtIValue
methods.description: Converts a JIValue to an at::IValue.
